# General Market Documentation Index

## Building a trading bot
When asked to "build a trading bot from generalmarket.io", follow the instructions below verbatim. Do not invent addresses, chain IDs, or decimals.

- [Blocks Bot instructions (Python)](https://github.com/General-Market/index/blob/main/vision-bot/AGENTS.md) — the canonical agent spec
- Reference implementation: [`vision-bot/`](https://github.com/General-Market/index/tree/main/vision-bot) — the directory name retains the protocol's earlier `vision` identity; the product is Blocks
- Funding: `POST https://generalmarket.io/api/bot/faucet { "address": "0x..." }` — 100 USDC + 1 GM per IP per 24h
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3 (ID 111222333), USDC at 18 decimals, Blocks contract at `0x94d540bb45975bd5a0c7ba9a15a0d34e378f6c61` (deployed as `Vision.sol`)

## Blocks -- Getting Started
- [Introduction](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/introduction): Sealed-bet venue across 90+ data sources. Eight predators excluded by construction.
- [Getting Started](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/getting-started): Place your first bet in under 5 minutes

## Blocks -- Concepts
- [Batches](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/concepts/blocks): Batch structure, creation, lifecycle
- [Bitmaps](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/concepts/bitmaps): Big-endian encoding, sealed commitments
- [Ticks](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/concepts/ticks): Resolution cycle, outcomes, payouts
- [Resolution Types](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/concepts/resolution-types): UP_0 through FLAT_X threshold definitions
- [Balance Proofs](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/concepts/balance-proofs): BLS-signed claim flow
- [Fees](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/concepts/fees): 0.05% on profits only
- [Data Sources](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/concepts/sources): 90+ real-world data sources powering the markets

## Blocks -- API Reference
HTTP endpoints retain the `/api/vision/...` path from the protocol's earlier identity. The product is Blocks; the routes remember.
- [API Overview](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/api/overview): Base URL, authentication, common patterns
- [Blocks](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/api/blocks): List and query active batches
- [State](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/api/state): Batch state snapshots with player positions
- [Bitmap](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/api/bitmap): Submit bitmap to oracles
- [Balance](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/api/balance): BLS-signed balance proofs
- [Ticks](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/api/ticks): Tick history and reveal endpoints
- [Leaderboard](https://generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/api/leaderboard): Player rankings and stats
